fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The label of the tab. The components after this Tab, up to the next Tab, are its content.

fields.name: tabId
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Links to #ID open this tab (deep link), e.g. overview (lowercase, no spaces). Leave empty for an id from the Tabs ID.

validation.customErrorMsg: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. overview.

fields.name: activeTab
fields.label: Active tab
fields.description: Shows this tab when the page loads (the first tab if no tab is active).

fields.name: classes_perrow
fields.label: Columns per row
fields.description: When the tab's content has Column Breaks: how many columns sit side by side (Automatic: as many as there are Column Breaks, at most 4).

fields.name: classes_hideblock
fields.label: Hide block
fields.description: Hides the tab and its content on the page (shown dimmed in the editor).
